name: r5-contact-control-off
description: THE CONTACT CONTROL PAIR, arm 1 of 2 — `noDamage: TRUE`, and the ONLY field that differs from `r5-contact-control-on`. R0's table listed `noDamage` on the JS side as a BOUNDED VACUITY whose witness was 'R5', because every fixture through R4 was recorded with the guard ON: nothing had ever driven the player into something that damages, so 'the walk was contact-free' and 'the guard swallowed every contact' produced identical streams and the model was never asked. This arm is the shut-before half. L8 boots the player at (40,128) and a held RIGHT walks them due east into `sandtrap@96,128` — a STATIC enemy, so its body is exactly where the census says and the contact tick is a prediction rather than a fit. With the guard on, `Player.hit` returns at :1361 before sound, shake, knockback and the i-frame window, so the walk continues straight through and the stream must match the contact-free model tick for tick.
